latestVersion.changelog:
MP3 Editor 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit audio (MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, up to 200MB) and export as 1080p MP4 video using simple instructions.
- No desktop software required—processing and rendering are entirely cloud-based.
- Automatic setup integrates free token management and secure session handling.
- Supports direct file uploads, credit checks, export status, and timeline previews.
- User commands instantly routed to upload, edit, export, or check credits/status.
- Clear error handling, attribution headers, and easy-to-follow usage guidance included.
